authorization: One newly authorized assessment of the preserved cosine candidate on9 original TUNE videos; HOLDOUT closed; no tuning or rescue search

candidate.inference: Unchanged ExperimentalEngine.analyze, including cold worker load, current extraction and conditional candidate JPEG path

selection.order: source SHA256 ascending; names/order/labels never model inputs
selection.duplicate_policy: Report exact-unique count; evaluate all9 original rows and never refit on TUNE

runtime_limits_scope: Owned child deadline is enforced; full driver hash/copy/persistence wall threshold is retrospective, not a hard I/O stop. System-RAM guards are discrete checks before/after load and inference batches, not continuous allocation guarantees
metrics: TN/FP/FN/TP and F1 only for completed results, with completed denominator
Failures/refusals separately, including their positive/negative truth counts; not silently negative
TP-only source candidate-frame point MAE/median with explicit count
Aggregate full wall distribution min,p25,median,p75,p95,max,mean,sum; no per-video output
Every wall includes source identity check/copy, cold process/import/model load, extraction/scoring/JPEG/schema, process cleanup and local persistence
retention: Private copied inputs/results/candidate JPEGs and per-video timings stay local and excluded from every public ledger/tool output; console aggregate only
stop: One attempt marker and one per-video owned process only. No repeat after quality, no parameter/prompt/window changes, no TUNE-derived prototype fit, no HOLDOUT, type/rule mapping or competition-release claim
